messages.author: 1fd926513d9cc1f3
messages.subject: sharing functions across stan files
parts:
hey stan user group,

I'm just starting out and cannot find the answer to this question: can I define functions that will be used in multiple stan models (and therefore stan files). For example, I would like to define a function foo that gets used in multiple models. my primary reason for this is to not re-use code that will likely be changing regularly while developing.

for example:

foo.stan:
functions{
int foo() {
// do something here
} 
}

m1.stan:
...
//somewhere in the stan file
foo()
...

m2.stan:
...
//somewhere in the stan file
foo()
...

thanks
Peter

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: Re: sharing functions across stan files
parts:
Hi!

RStan has an include functionality which you can use via the stanc_builder function.

For cmdstan you have to use tricks by abusing the C preprocessor which is easy to do via makefiles (search the mailinglist, I have posted this).

Luckily, a general include facility is in the making and will be included in Stan at some point.

Sebastian
